status: Confirmed in source; runtime needs test
finding: Auto style routing supports explicit handbag/wallet/backpack subtype conditions, but product-name matching is keyword-based and only applies the detailed subtype routing when product_type is bag.
effect: If Telegram category/subcategory values are inconsistent or a product name uses an unrecognised synonym, a bag can fall back to a generic bag style or wrong subtype candidates.
recommended_action: Normalize subtype labels and synonyms in one mapping function; validate selected style against subtype before prompt assembly.
test_case: Bonia handbag; Bonia wallet; laptop backpack; tote bag; crossbody sling; card holder.

finding: The generated storyboard prompt limits the selected style template to 70 characters, setting to 100, camera direction to 70, concept to 100, and universal framework preview to 180 characters. Main prompt construction therefore discards most of the stored directions.
evidence: main prompt_engine.py return block: style_template[:70], scene[:100], camera[:70], concept[:100]; concise_framework uses _universal_prompt_direction(style_key)[:180].
effect: The prompt sent to the video generator may contain only a fragment of the style/camera/setting instruction; sentence-level fixes alone do not preserve the full direction if the limits remain too short.
recommended_action: Use complete but concise sentence-aware summaries with explicit limits per component; do not slice raw strings. Keep the full selected storyboard and core safety rules intact.
test_case: Generate prompts with handbag_showcase, wallet_daily_carry, beauty_macro and a long custom setting; confirm no sentence fragment and meaningful style direction remains.

finding: Raw string slicing can cut a sentence mid-word or mid-sentence; the existing patch branch introduces _prompt_sentence for several fields, but this must be checked for every path and should be combined with sensible content limits.
evidence: main prompt_engine.py: style_template[:70], str(scene)[:100], camera[:70], concept[:100]; audit/prompt-truncation-category-match branch replaces some with _prompt_sentence.
effect: Fragments such as 'No capacity, durability or security...' can be emitted without the complete constraint.
recommended_action: Use a shared sentence-aware truncation helper across every prompt path, then run generated-output regression tests; avoid merely moving the cut to a sentence boundary if it removes the core instruction.
test_case: Long style, setting, camera and concept; custom universal category; storyboard and non-storyboard modes.

finding: Three universal framework style keys do not exist in STYLES: luxury_reveal, zoom, detail_macro. Framework lookup returns the first framework as fallback if no exact key matches.
evidence: prompts/universal_prompt_templates.json style_keys compared with prompt_catalog.py STYLES; _universal_prompt_direction fallback
effect: A style can silently receive the premium framework even if the intended direction was camera movement or detail focus.
recommended_action: Map each key to an existing canonical style or define it explicitly; avoid silent first-framework fallback for unknown keys.
test_case: Call _universal_prompt_direction for each referenced key, including luxury_reveal, zoom and detail_macro; assert the expected framework id.

finding: Many category hooks use the same generic imperative pattern, e.g. TENGOK BEG INI, TENGOK KASUT INI, TENGOK TELEFON INI; the wording is not varied by angle or product detail.
effect: Openings can sound repetitive and low-value across different products; the phrase may be spoken even when it does not fit the chosen voice/style.
recommended_action: Create a small curated set of natural Bahasa Melayu Malaysia hooks per category and ad angle; rotate wording without inventing benefits, urgency, prices or popularity.
test_case: Compare ten different products in the same category and across categories; check for repetitive first line and unsupported claims.

status: Potential cross-path conflict; confirm all callers
finding: build_prompt accepts prompt_language and passes it to _build_single_prompt, but the visible final prompt suffix unconditionally says a selected voice should use Bahasa Melayu Malaysia. The shown _build_single_prompt body does not use prompt_language to choose speech language.
evidence: prompt_engine.py build_prompt/_build_single_prompt signatures and final prompt suffix
effect: English voice selection may be overridden by a generic Malay instruction on some paths.
recommended_action: Thread prompt_language into the final spoken-copy instruction and make the language explicit; inspect callers and generated prompts before changing.
test_case: Run same product in Malay and English voice modes; assert prompt language differs correctly and only selected language is requested.

finding: Category actions and SFX have 10 groups, while product categories in the style map are broader. Several categories fall into home/general or gadget groups; travel is grouped with bag and pet/accessory-like items may fall to general.
effect: A category may get a technically plausible but generic or mismatched action/SFX; a travel product may be treated like a bag.
recommended_action: Keep common rules shared but map every supported category/subcategory to an intentional action/audio profile; use generic only as a clear fallback.
test_case: Test toy, baby, furniture, garden, kitchen appliance, travel luggage, jewellery, automotive and pet products.

finding: Camera direction is assembled separately from style templates, category actions and storyboard scene directions; several of these independently prescribe push-ins, slides, tracking or close-ups.
evidence: prompt_engine.py: CAMERAS, style templates, _CREATIVE_ACTIONS, _category_specific_scenes and prompt assembly
effect: Prompt can prescribe multiple moves within the same beat, contrary to the intended one-action/one-camera-move rule.
recommended_action: Treat style as visual look, camera as one selected move, and action as subject movement; run a conflict check or compose them into one shot direction.
test_case: Inspect generated prompts for each camera choice across fashion, bag, gadget and home; count incompatible simultaneous camera moves.

status: Confirmed rule overlap; behavior needs test
finding: Global rules prohibit unrequested on-screen text, while the white_doodle template permits selected verified hook/feature labels in some paths; different branches describe overlays differently.
evidence: prompt_catalog.py white_doodle template; prompt_engine.py white_doodle rules; prompts/universal_prompt_templates.json global_rules
effect: A generator may add text labels even where the user expected only animated doodles, or may suppress intended doodle features due to blanket no-text wording.
recommended_action: Separate non-text doodle graphics from text overlays; allow text only through an explicit user choice and a verified-text field.
test_case: Test white_doodle with text disabled and enabled; confirm no random labels, logos or captions.

finding: Detailed five-beat scene templates exist for fashion, hijab, shoes, bag, beauty and gadget, with conditional templates for beds and cookware sets. Other categories use more generic fallback scenes.
effect: Products such as toys, pet goods, garden tools, jewellery, stationery, travel gear and baby products may receive less distinctive scenes.
recommended_action: Add templates only where a category has distinct safe actions; otherwise improve generic fallback with one category-aware interaction and visible-detail beat.
test_case: Compare scene beat outputs for a handbag, lamp, toy, baby product, jewellery, stationery, pet accessory and gardening tool.

finding: Prompt source inventory alone does not prove that the selected human/animal model is suitable for the product age/category; the model-selector and Telegram choice path are outside this prompt-library check.
evidence: Scope limitation: audited prompt_catalog.py, prompt_engine.py and universal_prompt_templates.json only
effect: Adult clothing could be shown on an unsuitable model, or child clothing could inherit an adult persona if upstream selection is wrong.
recommended_action: Audit model selector and UI-to-prompt arguments as a separate path; preserve existing intended category defaults and add validation.
test_case: Child clothing/shoes, adult men's fashion, hijab, pet products and products with no human model.

finding: This inventory was extracted from repository source files; the production SQLite database loaded through KLIPPO_PROMPT_DB was not read or compared row-by-row.
effect: Source defaults may differ from active production rows because SQLite seeding is additive and preserves existing/customized rows.
recommended_action: Export the actual active storyboard_prompt_styles rows from the configured production DB in a safe, read-only way, then compare style_key, display_name, template, version and active against source defaults.
test_case: Compare count, missing/extra keys, template hashes, inactive rows and customized rows without modifying production.

finding: For split clips, continuation behavior is spread across _build_single_prompt and _creative_variation; part indices and handoff instructions must remain aligned for 20s/30s requests.
evidence: prompt_engine.py: build_prompt parts range and part-specific branches
effect: Part 2 may repeat a hook or mismatch its first-frame continuity if one branch interprets part numbering differently.
recommended_action: Standardize part numbering (zero- or one-based) and generate regression samples for each supported duration.
test_case: Check 20s two-part and 30s three-part output; Part 1 holds final frame, next part continues without repeating hook.

finding: The prompt combines identity rules, category directions, natural motion, framing, scene actions, style template, timed storyboard, creative variation, audio and quality rules; repeated instructions can compete for model attention.
effect: Long prompts can bury the most important requirements and duplicate instructions instead of strengthening them.
recommended_action: Compose a hierarchy: product lock; selected style; five-beat storyboard; one camera move/action per beat; selected voice/audio; short negative constraints. Remove repeated constraints only after regression tests.
test_case: Measure final prompt length and detect repeated/conflicting instructions across common styles and categories.

finding: Prompt inventory has English technical direction strings and Malay hook text; this is acceptable for many video models only if the selected spoken language and UI labels are separately clear and consistent.
evidence: prompt_engine.py templates; prompt_catalog.py hooks; user requirement for Bahasa Melayu Malaysia speech
effect: English instruction text itself is not necessarily a defect, but spoken copy may use the wrong language or sound unnatural if language selection is not propagated.
recommended_action: Keep technical instructions in one chosen prompt language if desired, but explicitly separate prompt instruction language from spoken-audio language and enforce Malaysian Malay wording for Malay speech.
test_case: Test Malay and English modes with Northern/Malaysian phrasing constraints; reject Indonesian wording and mixed-language spoken lines unless selected.

finding: The current audit checker flags missing framework keys, but an unknown key can fall through to the first framework without reporting a runtime error.
effect: Inventory can show an error while runtime silently produces a plausible but wrong result.
recommended_action: Add a validation test that fails for unregistered keys unless they are in an explicit alias map.
test_case: Assert all framework style keys resolve to exactly one canonical style or intentional alias.
